title: Mouse sensorimotor cortex reflects complex kinematic details during reaching and grasping
primary_outputs: Recompute neural encoding/decoding of joint motion and reach/grasp dynamics in M1 versus S1.
Test timing and detailed kinematics of movement disruption under supplied cortical interventions.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.input_level: Processed calcium, tracked3D joint kinematics, event timing and optogenetic MAT trials.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_bridge: Figshare inventory contains ten neural/kinematic MAT recordings, event timing, and two optogenetic MAT files. Author loadData.m loads R/M structures using documented mouse/session filenames; loadLock4Decode and decode.m transform those trials into the decoding analysis. Documentation specifies per-trial neural activity and 3D joint metadata.
